verdict.rationale: The SDK documents first-party sandbox agents that run inside real isolated workspaces with manifest-defined files, sandbox client selection, and resumable sandbox sessions. The CodeInterpreterTool also executes code in a sandboxed environment, so agents can be exercised without operating on live systems. missing for 10: explicit guidance on separating test/sandbox data from production data (e.g., mock or staging backends for tools), depth on sandbox isolation guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox workflow.
